title: Pointwise Kan coprojections are the unit followed by restriction
statement:
Fix a universe $\mathcal V$. Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal E$ be $\mathcal V$-small categories, let $b:\mathcal C\to\mathcal E$ be a functor, and let $\mathcal A$ be a category with $\mathcal V$-small morphism sets and all $\mathcal V$-small colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For a presheaf $F:\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal A$, let $K=\operatorname{Lan}_{b^{\mathrm{op}}}F$ and let $\lambda:F\to K\circ b^{\mathrm{op}}$ be the unit of the Kan-extension/restriction adjunction [lem-sfb-pointwise-kan-colimit]. For $W\in\mathcal E$, let $\mathcal I_W$ have objects $(V,\phi:W\to b(V))$ and morphisms $a:(V,\phi)\to(V',\phi')$ satisfying $b(a)\phi=\phi'$. Write
$$\alpha_W:K(W)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{colim}_{\mathcal I_W^{\mathrm{op}}}F(V)$$
for the canonical pointwise Kan comparison, and $\iota_{(V,\phi)}$ for the colimit coprojection. Then, as morphisms $F(V)\to K(W)$,
$$\alpha_W^{-1}\circ\iota_{(V,\phi)}=K(\phi)\circ\lambda_V.$$
Here $K(\phi):K(b(V))\to K(W)$ is restriction along $\phi$.
